about: Situational factors researched by session arena/a6f05f99 on 2026-10-15 22:40-23:15 UTC from official sources only (HLTV news and team pages, bo3.gg match pages, Valve's Regional Standings). 'risk_for' names the team the factor argues AGAINST. 'strength': strong = a change inside 60 days, a stand-in, or a late call-up; moderate = a change 60-120 days old; weak = context only. Only strong and moderate factors can trigger the SITUATIONAL leaderboard rule; weak ones are displayed but never move a pick. A factor never changes a probability - it only feeds the leaderboard rule, and it is always shown with the link it came from.

factors.kind: roster change (new in-game leader + new player + new coach)
factors.summary: Aurora rebuilt around their Turkish core (XANTARES, woxic, Wicadia) in July 2026: MAJ3R stepped down and soulfly was benched on 2 July, Jimpphat signed from MOUZ on 3 July, ash became head coach on 3 July and kyxsan joined from Falcons as in-game leader on 8 July. That is about 100 days before the day-3 decider, and the rebuilt five has since reached the StarSeries Fall final (HLTV news, 19 Sep 2026) and sits 5th on Valve's official standings. Treat the churn as a tiebreak on a close match, not as evidence of a broken team.
factors.counter_evidence: Aurora beat Ninjas in Pyjamas 2-0 on 15 Oct 2026 (Cache 13-9, Dust2 13-7) two days after the 9z loss, with Wicadia on a 1.65 rating, and HLTV lists them 6th in the world on 12 Oct 2026.

factors.kind: roster change (player swap 28 days before the event)
factors.summary: HObbit replaced the benched slaxejezzz on 17 Sep 2026. Valve's 2026-10-05 standings still list the old five, so Valve points describe a roster that no longer plays. PARIVISION lost 0-2 to Legacy and 1-2 to BetBoom and are eliminated from Thunderpick.

Ninjas in Pyjamas replaced Virtus.pro at Thunderpick after Virtus.pro withdrew (visa issue for AquaRS, health of F0R3VER); announced 9 Oct 2026. They lost 0-2 to Falcons and 0-2 to Aurora and are eliminated. They have an ordinary league match on 16 Oct against Team Liquid in which this factor no longer applies as an event-specific call-up, but the short preparation window does.

factors.kind: schedule load (third best-of-three in three days)
factors.summary: 9z played Aurora on 14 Oct 08:30 UTC, Falcons on 15 Oct 11:00 UTC and meet Aurora again on 16 Oct 14:00 UTC - three best-of-threes in three days at a LAN. Aurora's schedule is the same shape (14 Oct 08:30, 15 Oct 08:30, 16 Oct 14:00), so this is close to symmetric and is recorded as context only; it never moves a pick.

factors.kind: schedule load (third best-of-three in three days)
factors.summary: Same as the 9z entry above: Aurora also play their third best-of-three in three days on 16 Oct. Context only.
